description: Food festivals with their next resolved dates (read-only). Filter by city, country, a date window and text. Each item carries starts_on/ends_on for the next edition, the organiser source URL and the page to cite.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. 'new-york-city' or 'New York City'. Unknown cities answer with did_you_mean.
city.title: City

country.description: Country slug or name, e.g. 'italy'. Optional where city is given.
country.title: Country

date_from.description: Earliest end date to include, ISO. Defaults to today.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Latest start date to include, ISO.
date_to.title: Date To

query.description: Free text: festival name, food or drink.
query.title: Query

name: festivals
title: Find food festivals
